messages:
Elena (AP): Received AeroCloud INV-77231 for Mar, amount $6,480. No PO on the PDF and it looks like a duplicate of INV-77199 we paid last month. Can someone check?
Sana (Purchasing): Hmm vendor put 'Customer Ref: 2303-ENG-19' on the invoice. That doesn't match our PO format. I searched Coupa for 2303-ENG-19, nothing. @Ravi can you confirm whether we had an advance purchase for AeroCloud in March?
Ravi (EngOps): We had a short burst for dataset preprocessing Mar 4-5. I see a PO in Coupa: PO 2303-ENG-17 for AeroCloud (estimated $4,200). Different number. Could vendor be using their internal ref?
AeroCloud (Vendor): Hello Redwood team — thanks for flagging. Our system emitted two invoices due to billing batch retry. INV-77199 was adjusted then reissued as INV-77231. We can void one immediately if you confirm which to keep. The PO reference on our side is AC-2303-19 which maps to your 2303-ENG-17 per our PO import file.
Elena (AP): Please confirm in writing which invoice to void. AP will hold payment until resolved. Also missing PO linkage triggers auto-hold.
Sana (Purchasing): Two paths: (A) vendor voids 77199 and reissue corrected invoice with our PO 2303-ENG-17; (B) we raise a retro PO for 2303-ENG-19 mapping and route for approval. Preference: get vendor to correct.
Ravi (EngOps): Confirming usage: short job on Mar 4 12:00Z to Mar 5 02:00Z — logs attached in infra ticket INF-1293. Estimated vendor charges should be ~$4.2k, not $6.48k. Vendor please provide line-item rates.
AeroCloud (Vendor): Will void INV-77199 and reissue a single invoice corrected to reference PO 2303-ENG-17. Also sending line items CSV now.
approvals-bot: Approval request: Retro PO 2404-RETRO-2303 created by Sana pending manager sign-off. Link: https://coupa/po/2404-RETRO-2303 (status: DRAFT)
Leo (Infra): Quick note — if we create a retro PO, please set GL to `5003-InfraOps` and cost center `ENG-INFRA`. Ravi, can you confirm GL?
Ravi (EngOps): Yes GL `5003-InfraOps` is correct.
Sana (Purchasing): I'll hold off on retro PO routing; vendor will reissue. If reissue doesn't arrive by EOD tomorrow we'll proceed with the retro PO. Adding vendor contact: billing@aerocloud.co.
Elena (AP): Logged AP exception EX-4521, attached both PDFs and vendor email. Payment on hold. If vendor sends corrected invoice I'll approve for payment immediately.
Ravi (EngOps): Thanks — will monitor. If vendor rate sheet shows higher than expected, we'll escalate to procurement for rate negotiation.
Sana (Purchasing): FYI I couldn't map AC-2303-19 automatically because of a missing partner ID on their EDI file. Asked vendor to include our Coupa PO ID in the invoice description.
AeroCloud (Vendor): Reissued INV-77231-R with PO ref 2303-ENG-17 and line CSV attached. Please confirm receipt.
Elena (AP): Received the reissued invoice and CSV. The amount is now $4,210. Updating AP record and linking to PO 2303-ENG-17. Closing hold and scheduling payment for next AP run.
Sana (Purchasing): Great — I'll update Coupa mapping and note vendor EDI issue. Adding a short remediation: vendor to include 'Redwood PO' field in future CSVs.
Elena (AP): Marking EX-4521 resolved. Filing note for FYI and vendor follow-up. Thanks everyone.
